meta.title: Universal Supplier Passport | TRACEFAB Verified
meta.description: Verified Universal Supplier Passport on Tracefab. Industrial identity, active certifications and CSR compliance.

nda.title: Trade Secret Protection Active (EU Directive 2016/943)
nda.body: Exact factory addresses, nominal production capacities and exclusive subcontracting relationships are masked by default. Audited brands can request direct access to unlock the raw supporting documents.

sticky.title: Do you represent a fashion brand or a contracting party?
sticky.body: Connect your brand console to this passport to import the data in 1 click.

modal.title: Request full access
modal.intro: Fill in this form to notify the quality team at {supplier}. If you already have a Tracefab brand account, your workspaces will be interconnected automatically.
modal.messagePlaceholder: We would like to audit your GOTS certificates for our autumn 2026 collection…
modal.ndaLabel: I accept the confidentiality terms (NDA) and undertake not to disclose this supplier's industrial data to third parties.
modal.notified: The supplier has been notified of your request.
